name: aiortc
stack: aiortc (Python, asyncio): its own SDP, SCTP and RTP; ICE from aioice; DTLS through pyOpenSSL (OpenSSL); SRTP through pylibsrtp (libsrtp); codecs through PyAV (FFmpeg: libvpx VP8, H.264, libopus)
version: aiortc 1.16.0 with aioice 0.13.0, pyOpenSSL 26.4.0, cryptography 50.0.2, pylibsrtp 1.0.0, av 19.0.2 (peers/aiortc/image/requirements.txt, by SHA-256), on the image's CPython 3.12; sdp.py and rtp.py from the fork Brainwires/aiortc commit 2245f90 (branch fix/extmap-extension-attributes-1.16.0: the fixes for https://github.com/aiortc/aiortc/issues/1492 and for RTCP SDES chunk alignment, RFC 3550 6.5), to be dropped when upstream releases them
licence: BSD-3-Clause (aiortc, aioice, pylibsrtp, PyAV; PyAV's wheel bundles FFmpeg under the LGPL; test image only)

trickle.reason: aiortc gathers every candidate while it applies a local description and emits no icecandidate events: its descriptions carry all its candidates, none is trickled
trickle.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 rtcpeerconnection.py setLocalDescription (await self.__gather(), then add_transport_description)

iceRestart.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 rtcpeerconnection.py: no restartIce, createOffer() takes no iceRestart option

rollback.reason: aiortc cannot roll back a description
rollback.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 rtcpeerconnection.py setLocalDescription parses the description as an offer or answer: no "rollback" type

iceTcp.reason: aioice gathers UDP host, server-reflexive and relayed candidates only: TCP is only its way to a TURN server
iceTcp.cite: aioice 0.13.0 ice.py Connection.gather_candidates; turn_transport "udp" or "tcp" is the TURN server's transport

iceTcpActive.reason: aioice gathers UDP host, server-reflexive and relayed candidates only: TCP is only its way to a TURN server
iceTcpActive.cite: aioice 0.13.0 ice.py Connection.gather_candidates; turn_transport "udp" or "tcp" is the TURN server's transport

mdns.reason: aioice resolves a remote .local candidate but never hides its own host candidates behind an mDNS name
mdns.cite: aioice 0.13.0 ice.py: mdns is used to resolve remote candidates only (get_or_create_mdns_protocol, resolve); host candidates carry the interface address

simulcastSend.reason: aiortc sends one encoding per sender: no simulcast
simulcastSend.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 rtcrtpsender.py RTCRtpSender (one SSRC, no rid / simulcast in sdp.py's offer)

codec:vp9.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 codecs/__init__.py CODECS["video"]: VP8 and H.264 (with RTX) only

dtls13.reason: aiortc's DTLS is OpenSSL's DTLS_METHOD, DTLS 1.2 at most
dtls13.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 rtcdtlstransport.py create_ssl_context: SSL.Context(SSL.DTLS_METHOD); OpenSSL's DTLS goes to 1.2

answerUnbundled.reason: aiortc answers an offer without a BUNDLE group with one (a=group:BUNDLE 0 1), then still runs an ICE connection per section; the offerer bundles by that answer and aiortc's second connection never completes
answerUnbundled.cite: RFC 9143 7.3: "The answerer is only allowed to include a BUNDLE group in an initial BUNDLE answer if the offerer requested the BUNDLE group to be created in the corresponding initial BUNDLE offer"; train 10 round 3, cell `balanced, answered without BUNDLE` [aiortc]: received offer with no group, sent answer `a=group:BUNDLE 0 1`, aioice Connection(1) never completed

simulcastWithoutRid.reason: aiortc sends one encoding per sender: no simulcast
simulcastWithoutRid.cite: aiortc 1.16.0 rtcrtpsender.py RTCRtpSender (one SSRC, no rid / simulcast in sdp.py's offer)
